name: gitpulse
description: GitPulse control plane for agents: worktrees, collisions, ledger, provenance, in-process code intelligence, and the task board. It never pushes, and the skills that merge branches or pull requests act only after you approve their plan.

interface.longDescription: GitPulse exposes repository, worktree, collision, ledger, provenance, and code-intelligence tools to Codex, plus the task-board write tools (add, import, complete, merge, delete). It never pushes, and the skills that merge branches or pull requests act only after you approve their plan.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository with GitPulse before making changes.
